segments.source: Espresso Evolution is a compact entry machine with factory PID assistance, preinfusion and memo volume, rather than a smaller version of the Gaggia Classic. Its double-wall filters and ESE support offer a forgiving starting point, and the side tank can help where rear access is awkward. The plastic pannarello keeps milk preparation manual, while the portafilter system leads away from the Classic's 58 mm accessories. PID here also does not imply a user-facing temperature menu. The reviewed 230 V EG2115/01 suits someone who wants modest electronic help and simple dosing, with its cup clearance and accessory format accepted beforehand.
